title: Discovery plan
description: Operator declaration of one discovery run over a staged corpus version: the owner's source approval, the pool window, the audit sample, the pinned embedding worker, any ss-video hint files and the selection method. It grants no right and verifies no label.

run_id.description: Discovery run to write, which is also its directory name.

corpus_id.description: Staged corpus version the run reads.

source_approval.description: The owner's recorded approval to process these sources, the pinned sibling code and weights. ss-track cannot tell fixture media from real sources, so every run names one.

x-rules.text: Holds a character other than whitespace: text that is only whitespace is refused.

reference.description: Identifier of the owner's approval record.

pool.description: How each stream is cut into pool windows.

audit.description: The independent audit sample: one stratum per encounter group.

sample_size.description: Pool windows drawn per group, at most the group's windows.

embedding.description: Sibling embedding over staged frames, run out of process in a pinned environment.

package.description: The installed package that holds the embedders.

frame_stride.description: Embed every frame_stride-th frame of each bundle, from its first.

extractors.description: Extractors in ascending extractor_id order; each runs in its own worker process.

extractor_id.description: Name of the extractor within the run.

model.description: Model name the embedder loads, such as ViT-B-16 or dinov3_vitb14.

weights.description: Every weight file the extractor loads, in ascending name order.

items.description: One weight file the extractor must load, pinned by revision and bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the weight file bytes.

tiles.description: Embed square tiles that together cover each frame instead of the embedder's centre crop, so a small target near the frame edge is seen at a larger scale.

x-rules.tiles: Each tile position becomes an extractor of the run named <extractor_id>.r<row>c<column>, counted from 0; each such name is an identifier and no other extractor of the plan has it. A tile is square with side max(ceil(width / columns), ceil(height / rows)), which must not exceed the frame's shorter side.

selection.description: How the run ranks pool windows for review. Absent, the run ranks nothing and computes no score. A window of a stream in the locked split is never ranked.

oneOf.description: The baseline: a seeded simple random sample of budget eligible pool windows, each with the same known probability. It reads no score.

budget.description: Pool windows selection may rank for review, at most.

seed.description: Deterministic random seed, independent of the audit seed.

oneOf.description: Model-assisted and deterministic: windows are ranked by the mean percentile of the scores read, and each pick is penalised by its embedding similarity to windows already picked.

budget.description: Pool windows selection may rank for review, at most.

score_ids.description: Scores the selection reads, in ascending order.

x-rules.scores: score_ids are ascending and distinct, and each is motion, or <extractor_id>.deviation or <extractor_id>.instability for an extractor of this plan, whose embedding section is then required.

x-rules.order: extractors, weights and hints are in ascending order of extractor_id, name and hint_source_id, each appearing once.
x-rules.rights: source_approval names an approval held outside ss-track; this declaration grants no right.
